---
name: Release
about: What must be true before one release of one app is built
title: "Release <App> <version>"
labels: release
---
- [ ] Every must-have this version claims is true of `main`, each shown by a test, a picture or the tour.
- [ ] This build opens the files the previous release wrote.
- [ ] Every other issue in the milestone `<App> <version>` has its fix merged. This release closes them.
- [ ] The three lines of notes, New, Better and Fixed, say what a person will notice.
